How to choose an air fryer for your household

Start with what you actually cook: one batch of chips, two parts of a meal, or food on several trays. A basket, dual-drawer model and air-fryer oven use their space differently, so their headline capacities are not a like-for-like comparison.

Single basket, dual drawer or air-fryer oven?

A single basket is worth comparing for meals cooked as one batch. Dual drawers let you separate two foods, but each drawer is smaller than the advertised combined capacity. An oven-style design offers racks or trays; check their usable dimensions and the manufacturer’s instructions for cooking on multiple levels.

Capacity: look beyond the total quarts

Check basket or tray width, not only volume. A whole joint, several portions or flat food can need different shapes of usable space. Ask whether your normal meal fits without overcrowding or repeated batches. On a dual model, check each compartment separately. Measure counter depth and allow the clearances specified in the manual.

Two foods ready together: check the actual controls

Independent temperature settings, matching settings and synchronized finishing are different features. They matter when you want the main and side ready at the same time. Ninja’s US range identifies Smart Finish and Match Cook as distinct dual-zone features. Check whether the exact model offers coordinated finishing, copied settings or both. Source: Ninja manufacturer guidance. These are feature examples; they do not establish what another brand or model can do.

Cleaning and running costs can change the value

Check whether baskets, crisper plates and trays detach easily, whether replacement parts are available, and which parts the exact manual allows in a dishwasher. A viewing window may be convenient, but check how its surfaces are cleaned. Compare the complete meal rather than assuming a higher-wattage or larger machine always costs less to run.

New, open-box or refurbished: compare the whole offer

Check the stated condition, included trays and accessories, warranty and return window. A colour variant or another listing of the same model is an alternative offer, not evidence of a different-performing air fryer. Seller feedback concerns the seller; for cooking performance, look for comments about the exact model and food being cooked.

eBay vs Amazon: where should you compare?

For Air Fryers, it is worth checking both retailers rather than assuming one is always cheaper. eBay can be useful for new, refurbished and open-box stock and exposes seller feedback clearly. Amazon can be useful for comparing new-stock availability, delivery options and retailer returns where offered. Always compare the exact model number, condition, warranty, delivery cost and returns policy before deciding.

Buying questions answered

What size air fryer do I need?

Match the usable basket or tray to your normal meal. Check each drawer separately and consider whether you would need more than one batch.

Is a dual-drawer air fryer better than a single basket?

It can be convenient for two foods with different settings, while a single basket may suit one larger item. Compare the space you can actually use and whether coordinated finishing is supported.

Is an air-fryer oven the same as a basket air fryer?

Both may offer air-frying modes, but racks, trays and drawers have different usable spaces and cleaning requirements. Compare the exact appliance dimensions and instructions.

Does an air fryer always use less electricity?

Do not assume a universal saving. Compare the cooking time, power used and number of batches needed for the same meal.

What should I check on a refurbished air fryer?

Confirm condition, hygiene, included parts, warranty and returns. Do not treat a seller rating as a product-performance review.
